newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-HORRIFIC CRASH ENDS TURKISH CLUB'S SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HORRIFIC CRASH ENDS TURKISH CLUB'S SEASON.

text.p: Turkish second division club Erzincanspor will not play again this season following a horrific road crash that left two players and one club executive dead and 14 injured, a club official said.
"Five players are still in hospital, one is critically injured. We have nobody to play, the season is finished for us," club official Murat Demir told Reuters.
The Turkish Football Association has said the club will stay in the second division despite being unable to finish the season.
The accident happened last Friday when the club's minibus crashed into a tanker while travelling to Ankara for a league match. The tanker driver also died in the crash.
The Turkish F.A. has begun a campaign to help the club, with the executive board donating two billion lira ($16.5 million) to initiate it.
